g.text: Is just an array of numbers. Often used as coordinates of a point.
But they are just translations of a point.
Just the length of the vector
Multiplying a vector's length by a scalar. Scalar is just a float/int
Making a vector only have a length of 1, also known as unit vectors
Just showing vector as a sum of each axis multiplied by each
Common unit vectors are along the axes like X, Y and Z
It's kind of like casting a shadow of one vector to another.
The length of that shadow is the dot product
It's also kind of a similarity value between 2 vectors
Note you can also solve this as a transformation matrix
